name: Conditional Access Policy Tampering
description: Conditional Access is the set of rules that say who must use MFA, which apps they may open, and from where. An attacker who can add, weaken, or delete those policies can turn off MFA for themselves, exclude a risky app, or open a backdoor group. Joining a group that is allowed to edit policies is the same attack with an extra step. Policy edits should be rare, ticketed, and done by a named identity team — not by a freshly created user.
mitigations: Rotate credentials if the actor is compromised
